blocks.title: What is a GDG?
blocks.description: A Google Developer Group is a community of volunteers who create exciting projects and share experiences about Google technologies.

blocks.title: What is DevFest?
blocks.description: DevFests are community-led developer events hosted by Google Developer Groups around the globe.

team.description:
Google is known all around the world. Everyone is 'googling', checking on 'maps' and communicating in 'gmail'. For simple users, they are services that just works, but not for us. Developers see much more: APIs, scalability issues, complex technology stacks. And that is what GDG is about.

[Google Developers Group (GDG) Sweden](https://www.gdgsweden.se/) - is open and volunteer geek community who create exciting projects and share experience about Google technologies with a passion.

Our goal is to organize space to connect the best industry experts with international audience to boost development of IT.

attendingPage.description: How to get to DevFest Stockholm at Kista Entré, when the doors open, and what to expect at the venue.
attendingPage.online: Ask questions in the chat under the stream. Speakers answer them at the end of their talk.

gettingThere.text: From Stockholm Central Station, take the metro (blue line towards Akalla) to Kista station, about 17 minutes away.
From Stockholm Arlanda Airport (ARN), take the commuter train (pendeltåg) to Helenelund station, then a short bus ride or walk.
Parking is available around Kista Entré and Kista Galleria.

gettingThere.title: Public Transit
gettingThere.text: Use the SL app or sl.se to plan your trip to Kista station.

doors.note: Registration is at the main entrance. Bring your ticket, on your phone or on paper.

attendingPage.accessibility: Every room is step-free, with lifts between floors. Tell us what you need when you register, or ask any volunteer in a DevFest t-shirt.

accommodation.text: There are several hotels near Kista Entré, including Comfort Hotel Kista and Scandic Victoria Tower.

hotels.name: Comfort Hotel Kista
hotels.note: Next to Kista Galleria and close to the venue.

atVenue.text: Lunch and coffee are included. Tell us about allergies when you register.
